contrasts.label: Liver-associated change
contrasts.description: Concurrent liver tumor minus SQ-only control; distant SQ-tumor immune cells.

contrasts.label: Treg depletion contrast
contrasts.description: DT+ minus DT− in Foxp3-DTR mice with SQ and liver tumors; distinct experiment from the liver comparison.

contrasts.label: Anti-CTLA-4 contrast
contrasts.description: 9H10 minus isotype control in liver-tumor-bearing mice. This is NOT the 9H10 + anti-PD-1 combination.

contrasts.label: EZH2-inhibitor combination contrast
contrasts.description: CPI-1205 + anti-PD-1 minus anti-PD-1 alone in liver-tumor-bearing mice.
